payload.core_mechanism_summary: Predefine all lucky numbers up to 477; check if n consists of only 4,7; else test divisibility by each lucky number until one is found or all fail.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively searches over all possible lucky divisors. Although hardcoded, the approach conceptually matches generating lucky numbers via backtracking, making search_backtracking the most fitting among the available complete_search subtypes.
